svg.title: P18: Hybrid loop detection collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A2 · cycle role collaboration
Successive agent observations or actions can
A loop signal crosses a configured threshold or
The harness diagnoses a loop and stops, redirects,
Action or observation history is available
evidence and recorded in the trace.
A detector cannot block all exploration
Detector error, disabled mode, or false
Evidence: 8/41 repositories, 8/36 families; 8 trajectories (3 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: 2 supported, 0 unresolved, 1 rejected.
Variation: Action repetition, observation similarity, semantic signals, and composite thresholds.
Negative control: A recursion depth limit alone is not semantic loop detection.
